## New or updated project

<!-- One YAML file per project in `projects/`, based on resources/templates/project-card.yaml -->

- [ ] I added/updated `projects/<my-project>.yaml`
- [ ] Screenshot/thumbnail are URLs or small files (< 1.5 MB) under `projects/images/`
- [ ] `website` or `repo_url` is filled in; `demo_url` only if a working demo exists
- [ ] The "Validate project cards" check is green
